title: Zing H3 · 组件 FPS 与延迟

panels.title: Qwen VLM · latency (ms)
panels.description: Host 为调用返回耗时，CUDA 为当前 stream elapsed；不含输入等待、网络和播放。按 operation、实际分辨率、实例分开；只取 rank 0。 测量 encode_ids 前向；缓存命中跳过前向时无样本；完整请求 preprocessing/排队不包含在内。

targets.expr: 1000 * sum by (component, operation, resolution, instance) (rate(sglang_zing_component_duration_seconds_sum{component="qwen_vlm",measurement="$measurement",rank="0",region=~"$region",pool=~"$pool",resolution=~"$resolution"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (component, operation, resolution, instance) (rate(sglang_zing_component_duration_seconds_count{component="qwen_vlm",measurement="$measurement",rank="0",region=~"$region",pool=~"$pool",resolution=~"$resolution"}[$__rate_interval]))

1000 * histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le, component, operation, resolution, instance) (rate(sglang_zing_component_duration_seconds_bucket{component="qwen_vlm",measurement="$measurement",rank="0",region=~"$region",pool=~"$pool",resolution=~"$resolution"}[$__rate_interval])))

1000 * histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, component, operation, resolution, instance) (rate(sglang_zing_component_duration_seconds_bucket{component="qwen_vlm",measurement="$measurement",rank="0",region=~"$region",pool=~"$pool",resolution=~"$resolution"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Qwen VLM · FPS
panels.description: 处理 FPS = 同批完成计时的像素帧数 / 组件执行秒数；吞吐 FPS = 独立有效处理帧计数 completed_frames_total 的每秒增量（不受 CUDA 计时丢样影响），包含业务空闲影响。CUDA 计时及配对计算帧在异步完成后更新；有效处理帧在成功返回/交付时更新。 Qwen 计采样媒体帧（单图算 1），不计 temporal padding；纯文本输入 FPS=0，延迟仍有效。Host 为调用返回耗时，CUDA 为当前 stream elapsed；不含输入等待、网络和播放。按 operation、实际分辨率、实例分开；只取 rank 0。 测量 encode_ids 前向；缓存命中跳过前向时无样本；完整请求 preprocessing/排队不包含在内。

targets.expr: sum by (component, operation, resolution, instance) (rate(sglang_zing_component_frames_total{component="qwen_vlm",measurement="$measurement",rank="0",region=~"$region",pool=~"$pool",resolution=~"$resolution"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (component, operation, resolution, instance) (rate(sglang_zing_component_duration_seconds_sum{component="qwen_vlm",measurement="$measurement",rank="0",region=~"$region",pool=~"$pool",resolution=~"$resolution"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (component, operation, resolution, instance) (rate(sglang_zing_component_completed_frames_total{component="qwen_vlm",rank="0",region=~"$region",pool=~"$pool",resolution=~"$resolution"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: CUDA 计时丢样 · 每秒
panels.description: 队列满、CUDA 事件失败或超过 120 秒未完成会丢弃观测，不阻塞模型；丢样会影响统计代表性。

targets.expr: sum by (component, reason, instance) (rate(sglang_zing_component_timing_dropped_total{region=~"$region",pool=~"$pool"}[$__rate_interval]))
